instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Nova is a specialized music rights and publishing entity managing an extensive catalog of 5,000 songs spanning various genres. The company handles complex royalty collection across multiple territories, manages sync licensing for film and advertising, and maintains strict copyright enforcement protocols. While the core operations are stable, significant friction exists between legacy manual tracking systems and the rapidly evolving demands of digital streaming platforms.
answers.pastInitiatives: We experimented with a customer self-service portal two years ago after seeing competitors offer similar functionality but failed to achieve meaningful adoption due to a lack of deep market insight. We built an MVP for AI similarity detection internally in 3 months, which proved technically feasible but lacked the necessary data pipeline integration and operational support for real-time infringement monitoring.
answers.strategicGoals: Targeting 30% year-over-year top-line growth. We see untapped demand in adjacent customer segments like direct-to-consumer fan engagement tools and are evaluating whether to build, buy, or partner to accelerate market penetration into these areas. The core question is whether to deepen our vertical specialization in high-value sync licensing or broaden horizontally into related product categories.
answers.additionalContext: The company is currently balancing the need to modernize aging back-end financial systems with the urgent requirement for scalable data infrastructure needed to support future AI-driven revenue forecasting.
answers.teamSize: We have a dedicated innovation squad of 8 people — 4 engineers, 1 data scientist, 1 UX designer, 1 product manager, and a part-time business analyst. This team operates with its own sprint cadence separate from the core product teams and has an allocated annual innovation budget. They report progress quarterly to the executive committee.

opportunities.title: Automated Royalty Tracking Pilot
opportunities.rationale: Implementing a phased rollout of automated royalty tracking tools directly addresses the core struggle with manual workflows and provides immediate ROI by reducing overhead in collection. This is a low-risk, high-certainty incremental step that improves efficiency without requiring major cultural shifts.

first_actions: Select one key streaming platform integration point (e.g., Spotify)
Define MVP requirements for data ingestion and reconciliation
resources_needed: External consulting support for initial setup ($10k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce manual royalty reconciliation time by 30%
milestones: Q1: Data pipeline established and tested
Q2: Automated reconciliation live on one platform

opportunities.title: Streamlined Sync Licensing Workflow Tool
opportunities.rationale: Developing a lightweight internal tool to manage the documentation, submission tracking, and feedback loop for sync licensing requests will capture immediate efficiency gains in a high-value area. This builds on existing talent and solves a clear operational pain point.

first_actions: Conduct workflow mapping workshops with legal and creative teams
resources_needed: Light investment in a CRM integration tool ($3k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Decrease average sync request turnaround time by 20%
milestones: Q1: Workflow mapped and MVP built
Q2: Pilot usage with the internal team

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Music Similarity Detection for Infringement Monitoring
opportunities.rationale: By investing in advanced AI modeling, Nova can move beyond reactive manual monitoring to proactively identifying potential copyright infringements using machine learning. While technically ambitious, the risk is contained by keeping this as a data science project rather than an immediate operational overhaul.

first_actions: Identify and secure a dedicated Data Scientist for 1 year
Establish clean, labeled dataset pipeline from existing infringement reports
Define clear performance KPIs for detection accuracy (e.g., >85% precision)
resources_needed: Cloud compute resources and ML platform license ($20k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 85% detection accuracy on test data within 12 months.
milestones: Q4: Pilot integration into monitoring system

next_steps.action: Conduct a deep dive assessment of existing talent gaps and specialized training needs related to data science for the innovation squad.
Formalize and prioritize the scope for the Automated Royalty Tracking Pilot, securing necessary budget allocation from executive leadership.
Establish a formal 'Innovation Sandbox' process to allow the squad flexibility in testing radical ideas within the constrained 3% budget and informal culture.

key_weaknesses: Low digital maturity (Level 2) leading to reliance on manual, spreadsheet-based operations.
High dependence on informal decision-making causing misalignment between innovation efforts and core business strategy.
Potential talent gap in specialized data science skills required for future AI initiatives.
Limited budget allocation (3%) severely restricting the scope of radical or large incremental projects.
